queer_characters.name: Elena Alvarez
queer_characters.notes: Elena discovers her lesbian identity, comes out to her family, founds a Gay-Straight Alliance, and enters a romantic relationship with Syd; storyline centers her cultural identity and was called revolutionary.

queer_characters.name: Syd
queer_characters.notes: Described in the source as a nonbinary character who becomes Elena's romantic partner in season two.
